name: Scholarship/Stipend to SC Students for ITI/Professional Courses (Swami Vivekanand Scholarship)
benefit: •	Under the scheme, a monthly stipend of ₹400/- is given to the eligible student.
_eligibility_text:
1. The student should belong to the Scheduled Caste of Gujarat.
   1. The student should be studying in professional course in a Government or Private Industrial Training Institute (ITI).
   1. The annual family income of the student should be up to ₹6,00,000/- (For Rural &amp; Urban Areas).
